name: Continental Magic Association
declaringWar: Magic is the privilege of the strong. Let us see what you are capable of.
attacked: Foolishness. You challenge the pinnacle of magic.
defeated: An unexpected outcome... Perhaps this era truly belongs to humans.
introduction: I am Serie, founder of the Continental Magic Association. Do you possess the ambition to grasp true magic?
neutralHello: Speak quickly. My time is precious.
tradeRequest: An exchange of grimoires and resources? Let us hear it.

name: Demon King Army
declaringWar: I wish to understand human malice and coexistence. Die for my experiment.
attacked: Curse of Gold will turn your lands into eternal statues.
defeated: So this is... defeat. Still, I do not comprehend human emotions.
introduction: I am Macht, one of the Seven Sages of Destruction. Humans and demons cannot coexist, yet I still seek to understand you.
tradeRequest: Even demons understand the value of a temporary truce.
